name: Would you rather: absurd
description: Silly everyday either-ors, no gross-out, no drama.

que-prefieres-absurdos-desayunar-toda-la.text: Breakfast for the rest of your life:

options: A honk every time you laugh
A sad trombone every time you get angry
Hiccups that sound like a duck
Darth Vader voice when you tell the truth
A whole summer at 40 °C with no AC
A whole winter at 5 °C with no heating
Infinite battery but painfully slow internet
Perfect internet but only 1 hour of battery
Everyone calls you by a ridiculous nickname
Your theme song plays when you walk in
You get a round of applause when you leave

que-prefieres-absurdos-comer-toda-la-vid.text: Eat for the rest of your life:

options: Your phone always lands screen down
The toilet paper always runs out on you
You always pick the slowest checkout line
The elevator is always on your floor when you call it
